class.name: TireSkid
class.brief_description: Generates skid mark ribbons at tire contact points using procedural mesh geometry.
class.description:
TireSkid is a [Node3D] that creates and manages skid mark ribbons. It is created automatically as a child of each [Wheel] node and should not be added manually. Skid marks are rendered as triangle-strip ribbons on a procedurally generated [ArrayMesh].
The skid system uses fixed-size ring buffers for performance (no runtime allocations). Once a ribbon reaches its maximum point count or the tire stops sliding, the ribbon is finalized and fades out over [code]LIFETIME[/code] seconds before being recycled.
[b]Note:[/b] TireSkid reparents itself to the current scene root on ready, so skid marks stay in world space even if the vehicle moves.
